title: TenancyLocationResumedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.location.resumed` version 1: a paused location takes orders again before its moment. The envelope's `partner_id` is the location's partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner of the location, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.
